messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: LATENCY_SLO_BURN - p99 latency  > 2000ms for /v1/chat.generate in eu-west-1. Trigger: p99 > 1500ms for 5m. Pager: alice (oncall).

pagerduty-bot: Alert created (PD-4021). Severity: high. Notified rotation.

alice (oncall): acked. On it. Anyone oncall in eu-west-1?

bob (eng-sre): i'm here. Seeing the alert on dashboards too — p50 ~120ms, p95 ~320ms, p99 jumping to ~2100ms. Traffic spike starting ~4m ago.

carla (runtime): checking runtime traces... lots of requests falling back to host-level queue. KV-cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 10% for chat models in eu-west-1. also GPU mem pressure on nodes: OOM evictions?

dave (platform): autoscaler shows a backlog; HPA didn't scale because observed CPU on the pods is low (work is waiting on GPU/queue). Looks like autoscaler using CPU metric is ineffective for inference pods.

alice (oncall): TL;DR: p99 high due to kvcache misses + autoscaler not reacting. Impact: host-chat endpoints slow for some tenants; customers on Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 see degraded tail latency.

eve (support): Support queue getting 3x messages about slow responses from customers in EU. Flagging enterprise accounts A, B for potential SLA impact.

bob (eng-sre): repro logs from runtime:
```
2026-03-14T12:08:02Z runtime: kv_cache_miss key=conv_prefix_abc size=120
2026-03-14T12:08:03Z runtime: gpu_mem=0.92 total=24GB pod=inf-worker-3
2026-03-14T12:08:03Z runtime: request_enqueue latency=2300ms
```

carla (runtime): hmm. there's a cold-start storm on underlying workers (lots of model load requests). The memory pressure prevents new containers from starting so requests queue. Two mitigation paths: 1) force scale up dedicated inference pool (add nodes/GPU), 2) enable model variant fallback (serve quantized small variant) for latency-sensitive route.

alice (oncall): let's do both in parallel. @dave can you scale nodepool eu-west-1-dedicated + @carla initiate fallback routing for /v1/chat.generate to redwood-small-q4 for 5m?

dave (platform): starting nodepool scale. Running:
```sh
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize eu-dedicated-ig --size 5
kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/dedicated-inference-gpu
```
Estimated time ~2-3m to new nodes join.

carla (runtime): enabling soft-fallback in router for route /v1/chat.generate:
```yaml
route: /v1/chat.generate
policy:
  - allow: redwood-small-q4
  - fallback_window: 300s
  - prefer_low_latency: true
```
Applied. Starting to route 30% -> fallback over next 30s.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4021 acknowledged by alice (oncall) at 12:09:15Z.

alice (oncall): while nodes spin up, i'm going to reduce batch size for the main model to reduce mem footprint. @carla can you patch inference-config?

carla (runtime): patching config: lowering max_batch_size 64 -> 32, kv_cache_prefetch true -> false for hot-path.
```sh
kubectl -n model apply -f patch-batchsize.yaml
```
Patch applied. Rolling restart of deployment model-x-runner.

bob (eng-sre): watching metrics. p99 starting to drop a bit — 2100 -> 1200ms within 90s. queue length down ~40%.

dave (platform): new nodes are ready and registered (3 -> 5). Dedicated pool capacity increased.

carla (runtime): after fallback ramp and batch-size patch: kv-cache hit back to ~75%, GPU mem stabilized at ~0.6, queue latency down. traces show requests hitting redwood-small-q4 for some flows.

alice (oncall): can we verify p99 now?

bob (eng-sre): current metrics (12:13Z): p50 110ms, p95 260ms, p99 480ms. Still above target 250ms p99 but a huge improvement.

eve (support): not seeing new customer tickets after mitigation step. pinging accounts A, B with status update.

carla (runtime): will keep fallback for 10 more minutes then start gradual ramp back to main model when all nodes warmed and kv cache filled. also scheduling a hotfix to make autoscaler use queue_length/gpu_util rather than CPU.

alice (oncall): good work. Next actions: (1) keep increased capacity for 20m, (2) monitor p99 and progressively disable fallback after 10m, (3) create follow-up ticket to adjust autoscaler metric and add KV cache warming during deploy. I'll attach runbook notes.

bob (eng-sre): creating follow-up: INF-4892 "autoscaler: use queue-length/gpu-util metric & warm KV cache" and assigning to eng-platform + runtime.

incident-bot: Incident update: LATENCY_SLO_BURN (PD-4021) mitigated. Current p99 480ms (was 2100ms). Root cause suspected: cold-start storm + autoscaler metric mismatch. Postmortem assigned: INF-4892.

alice (oncall): closing pager. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PD-4021 resolved by alice (oncall) at 12:15:19Z.
